spr.description: Draw a hardware sprite from the sprite sheet. Width and height are in 8-pixel cells, 1 through 4.
spr.notes: Hardware sprites are submitted each frame. Sheet/variant IDs depend on project assets. See docs/PRESCALED_SPRITES.md for scaling limits.

parameterDocs.id: Sheet cell ID; built-in fallback has cells 0-3.

spr8.description: Draw one 8x8 hardware sprite from a sheet-relative tile index.
spr8.notes: Hardware sprites are submitted each frame. Sheet/variant IDs depend on project assets. See docs/PRESCALED_SPRITES.md for scaling limits.

sspr.description: Draw a sheet rectangle; unscaled coordinates must align to tiles. Scaled sizes must be declared as build-time sprite variants.
sspr.notes: Hardware sprites are submitted each frame. Sheet/variant IDs depend on project assets. See docs/PRESCALED_SPRITES.md for scaling limits.

ssprv.description: Draw a declared pre-scaled sprite variant. False means invalid, offscreen, or sprite list full.
ssprv.notes: Hardware sprites are submitted each frame. Sheet/variant IDs depend on project assets. See docs/PRESCALED_SPRITES.md for scaling limits.

spr_pal.description: Select palette line 0-3 for subsequent sprites this frame; default 1.

spr_prio.description: Select priority for subsequent sprites: 1 in front of high-priority tiles, 0 behind.

cls.description: Clear the current drawing mode and reset the text cursor. Preserve the bitmap clip.

camera.description: Set camera position for hardware scrolling and sprite coordinates; no arguments resets to zero.

color.description: Set the default drawing color, a PICO-style palette index 0-15.

pset.description: Set a bitmap pixel. Activates the 256x160 bitmap engine if needed.

pget.description: Read a bitmap pixel; return zero if outside bounds or bitmap mode is inactive.

rect.description: Draw a bitmap rectangle outline with inclusive corners.

rectfill.description: Draw a filled bitmap rectangle with inclusive corners.

clip.description: Restrict bitmap drawing to a rectangle; previous=true intersects the current clip. clip() resets it.
clip.notes: The current runtime preserves clip across cls. A stale builtins.js comment says otherwise; see docs/PICO_RUNTIME.md and bitmap_clear regression.

backdrop.description: Select the backdrop CRAM entry, 0-63; entries 0-15 use the PICO-style line.

screen_off.description: Blank the display; pair with screen_on after a controlled update.

pal.description: Remap a PICO-style color to another color in Genesis CRAM. pal() resets all 16.

hud.description: Reserve top tile rows, 0-27, for an unscrolled window-plane HUD. hud(0) releases it.

shade_mode.description: Enable or disable Genesis shadow/highlight mode.

fade.description: Scale the palette toward black or white. Amount is 0-1; fade(0) restores it.

hscroll.description: Set plane B horizontal scroll for one scanline, 0-223.

map_show.description: Display the build-bundled PNG tilemap on plane B, usually once in _init.

layer_show.description: Unsupported on Genesis: compilation deliberately fails. Do not use this as a plane visibility API.

layer_pri.description: Unsupported on Genesis: compilation deliberately fails. Set priority through tile attributes instead.

layer_scroll.description: Scroll a hardware plane. Layer 1 is plane A; plane B is owned by camera/hscroll.

tget.description: Read a hardware tilemap cell in the shown plane area; separate from PICO map RAM.

tset.description: Write a hardware tilemap cell; separate from PICO map RAM.

map.description: Stamp PICO map RAM cells onto plane B. Defaults: 0,0,0,0,128,64,unfiltered. A supplied flag mask matches any set bit.

mget.description: Read a tile from 128x64 PICO map RAM; out-of-bounds reads return zero.

mset.description: Write a byte tile ID to PICO map RAM; out-of-bounds writes do nothing.

fget.description: Read a sprite flag byte, or one bit as 0/1. Sprite range 0-255; bit range 0-7.

fset.description: With two arguments replace a flag byte; with three, change one bit.

anim.description: Return a looping animation frame in the inclusive range first..last. Slot range 0-31.

anim_once.description: Play an animation once and hold its final frame.

anim_pingpong.description: Return a frame from a back-and-forth animation cycle.

anim_done.description: Return 1 when a once-animation has finished, otherwise 0.

btn.description: Return whether a controller button is held.
btn.notes: Buttons: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down, 4 B/O, 5 C/X, 6 A, 7 Start, 8 X, 9 Y, 10 Z, 11 Mode. Player defaults to 0; valid players are 0 and 1. Extra buttons need a six-button pad. Invalid inputs return false.

parameterDocs.button: Controller button ID; see mapping below.

btnp.description: Return whether a controller button was newly pressed this game loop. No auto-repeat.
btnp.notes: Buttons: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down, 4 B/O, 5 C/X, 6 A, 7 Start, 8 X, 9 Y, 10 Z, 11 Mode. Player defaults to 0; valid players are 0 and 1. Extra buttons need a six-button pad. Invalid inputs return false.

parameterDocs.button: Controller button ID; see mapping below.

music.description: Play an XGM2 song bank entry; loop defaults true. music(-1) stops. Without a bank, use the built-in demo tune.
music.notes: WAV/song banks come from mdlua.json sfx/music arrays. XGM2 and standalone PCM share the Z80; switching drivers replaces the active driver. Physical PicoCalc audio is separate: the current player defaults to dummy audio.

sfx.description: Play a WAV-bank effect through XGM2; without a sample bank use a PSG blip. Channels 2, 3 and 4 are supported.
sfx.notes: WAV/song banks come from mdlua.json sfx/music arrays. XGM2 and standalone PCM share the Z80; switching drivers replaces the active driver. Physical PicoCalc audio is separate: the current player defaults to dummy audio.

pcm_sample.description: Return an opaque ROM pointer to a WAV-bank PCM sample, for standalone SGDK PCM calls.
pcm_sample.notes: WAV/song banks come from mdlua.json sfx/music arrays. XGM2 and standalone PCM share the Z80; switching drivers replaces the active driver. Physical PicoCalc audio is separate: the current player defaults to dummy audio.

pcm_len.description: Return the sample byte length for a WAV-bank entry.
pcm_len.notes: WAV/song banks come from mdlua.json sfx/music arrays. XGM2 and standalone PCM share the Z80; switching drivers replaces the active driver. Physical PicoCalc audio is separate: the current player defaults to dummy audio.

pcm_driver.description: Load the standalone Z80 PCM driver.
pcm_driver.notes: WAV/song banks come from mdlua.json sfx/music arrays. XGM2 and standalone PCM share the Z80; switching drivers replaces the active driver. Physical PicoCalc audio is separate: the current player defaults to dummy audio.

pcm_play.description: Play a WAV-bank sample through the standalone PCM driver. Pass rate and loop explicitly, for example 3,false.
pcm_play.notes: WAV/song banks come from mdlua.json sfx/music arrays. XGM2 and standalone PCM share the Z80; switching drivers replaces the active driver. Physical PicoCalc audio is separate: the current player defaults to dummy audio. Descriptor marks rate/loop optional, but current generic emitter supplies -1 for omitted values. A missing loop therefore becomes true in the runtime; do not rely on inferred defaults.

demo_sprite.description: Return the bundled two-frame SpriteDefinition handle for the SGDK sprite engine.
demo_sprite.example:
function _init()
  SPR_init()
  local s=SPR_addSprite(
    demo_sprite(),100,100,0)
end
demo_sprite.notes: Hardware sprites are submitted each frame. Sheet/variant IDs depend on project assets. See docs/PRESCALED_SPRITES.md for scaling limits.

realframes.description: Return the video interrupt count, independent of slow game-loop drawing.

realsecs.description: Return elapsed real seconds using nominal 60 Hz NTSC or 50 Hz PAL interrupts.

t.description: Alias of time: game-loop time in 16.16 seconds, advancing by 1/60 per loop.

time.description: Return game-loop time in 16.16 seconds, advancing by 1/60 per loop, even in PAL.

run.description: Restart the cartridge from reset, restoring initial globals and runtime state; does not return.

reset.description: Alias of run: restart the cartridge from reset; does not return.

save.description: Save up to 254 bytes from an array8 to SRAM slot 0-127, bounded by array capacity.
save.example:
local data=array8(2,0)
function _init()
  data[1]=11 data[2]=22
  save(0,data,2)
end

load.description: Load SRAM bytes into an array8; return byte count read, or zero for an unwritten/invalid slot.
load.example:
local data=array8(2,0)
function _init()
  local n=load(0,data,2)
end

array.description: Declare a fixed-capacity numeric array at top level. Public indexing is 1-based; optional initial value is constant.

array8.description: Declare a fixed-capacity byte array at top level; values are 0-255 and public indexing is 1-based.
array8.notes: One byte per element; ordinary numeric arrays use four-byte int/long elements on this M68K ABI. An older cheatsheet says half the RAM; compiler/emit.js emits unsigned char versus int/long arrays.

pool.description: Declare a fixed-capacity struct pool at top level. Use add, all and del for entities.

count.description: Return array capacity or live entity count for a top-level array/pool.

add.description: Add a table-literal entity to a fixed-capacity pool; this is a statement, not a returned entity.

del.description: Remove the current all-loop entity from its pool.
del.example:
local entities=pool(8)
function _update60()
  for e in all(entities) do
    del(entities,e)
  end
end

ord.description: Return one byte code from a compile-time string. Index defaults 1 and must be in bounds.

chr.description: Create a compile-time string from one or more constant byte values 0-255.

sub.description: Extract a compile-time substring with constant 1-based positions; omitted last means end of string.

tonum.description: Convert a static decimal string or constant number to a number; not a general runtime parser.

tostr.description: Convert a compile-time value to a static string; runtime string allocation is not supported.

type.description: Return a statically known type name. Runtime calls cannot be folded away inside type.

split.description: Declare a top-level static numeric array from a literal separated string; not a dynamic string-list API.
split.notes: Separator may be a static string or positive integer chunk length. Numeric conversion defaults true and cannot be disabled; top-level declaration only.

print.description: Draw a string or number using positioned or cursor form.
print.returns: No usable return: runtime C functions return void, although the compiler descriptor says int. Use print as a statement.
print.notes: Descriptor/runtime return mismatch is reported here, not corrected by this browser.

flr.description: Round toward negative infinity and return an integer.

ceil.description: Round toward positive infinity and return an integer.

abs.description: Return absolute value, subject to the SDK numeric limits.

sgn.description: Return -1, 0 or 1 according to the sign; sgn(0) is zero.

min.description: Return the smaller of two numbers; also accepts a constant numeric list as one argument.

max.description: Return the larger of two numbers; also accepts a constant numeric list as one argument.

mid.description: Return the middle of three values; useful for clamping.

sin.description: Sine using turns (1 is a full circle); PICO-style screen-inverted sign.

cos.description: Cosine using turns (1 is a full circle).

atan2.description: Return a PICO-style direction angle in turns.

rnd.description: Return a random number below limit (default 1), or choose from a constant list.

band.description: Bitwise AND; same compiler operation as the bitwise operator.

shr.description: Arithmetic right shift, preserving the sign.

lshr.description: Logical right shift, inserting zero bits.

all.description: Compiler loop form: iterate live entities in a top-level pool. Not an ordinary callable function.
all.example:
local entities=pool(8)
function _update60()
  for e in all(entities) do
    del(entities,e)
  end
end

hexdata.description: Declare a compile-time byte blob from an even-length hexadecimal string at top level. Name it __p8map to initialize PICO map RAM.

_init.description: Runs once at cartridge startup. Define it; do not call it yourself.

_update60.description: Game update callback, once per loop; slow drawing reduces rate. Define it; do not call it yourself.

_update.description: Alternative update callback, every other game loop. Define it; do not call it yourself.

_draw.description: Drawing callback, once per game loop. Define it; do not call it yourself.
